summary: Leading root cause (to be proven by the red e2e test before any fix): the unrecorded-mark sweep (packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/docs/marks.go sweepUnrecordedMarks) removes an open composer's provisional mark about 62 s after it is written (settlement at +2 s records first-seen; re-armed settlement at TTL 1 min), so Send's mark_id is refused 409 ANCHOR_MISSING by VerifyMark after markWait 1 s. Fix in two layers: (1) server: the sweep keeps an unrecorded mark whose `by` (bare login from the browser, or user:<login>) names a user connected to the room, resetting its first-seen time, with `by` read in the sweep's single tree walk; VerifyMark re-reads once when its timer fires. (2) browser: proof-editor tracks the composer's mark range through transactions and can re-write a fresh provisional mark over the same text; Send awaits the document's pending count reaching zero (bounded 5 s); on ANCHOR_MISSING the margin re-anchors once and retries as a new press (store.readdress + store.retry, fresh Idempotency-Key); when the text is gone the composer shows a reader message and keeps the draft.
